status: Predeclared before new runs; retrospective descriptive stress, not holdout
rule: Frozen ten-month total-return moving-average trend; 99% target; integer shares; no tuning
new_variant: Delayed staged orders: retain close-sized quantity; fill next open plus additional sessions; reject unaffordable buys; do not use future opens for sizing. Delay applies independently to sale and subsequent buy.
benchmarks: Existing frozen SPY monthly cash reinvestment and monthly 49.5/49.5 SPY/BIL; no tax or cash interest
cost_exposure_diagnostic: Replay fixed zero-cost fill quantities; subtract cumulative absolute raw opening notional times bps from gross NAV. This isolates direct cost and is monotonic; it is NOT a feasible cash-constrained trading simulation.
metrics: daily Sharpe with zero risk-free rate
decision_rule: No claim of investment advantage unless trend improves net risk-adjusted results consistently across periods and cost/delay stresses. Operational proxy: higher zero-risk-free Sharpe than both benchmarks in all scenarios and no worse drawdown. Failure means no-go for efficacy claim; passing is still descriptive, not proof.
subscription_drag: 300 USD per calendar month external expense, subtract ending wealth, not brokerage fee or internally resimulated cost
limitations: Calendar regimes selected with knowledge of history
Long sample uses known imperfect frozen Yahoo ex-date accounting, including old distribution anomalies; exploratory only
Recent payment dates are validated retrospectively, not point-in-time
No liquidity, taxes, market impact, spread variation or independent delayed-engine validation
Existing strategy and all these periods already observable; no statistical independence or untouched holdout
